# Top-and-bottom wrapping across paragraphs

Original XML/OPC and PNG controls generated by `tools/top_bottom_flow_fixture.py`;
no third-party document engine or template content is used. Regeneration uses
only Python's standard library. `control.docx` has twelve pages, one case per
page; `cases.json` records the six drawing-band arrangements paired with an
empty or nonempty following 8 pt paragraph. A 22 pt empty paragraph with
12.05 pt before-spacing precedes the final text marker. Drawing anchors use
paragraph-relative positions, zero text distances, and compatibility mode 15.

`native.json` records all 30 visible text baselines from a fresh native reference
Save As PDF export on 2026-09-30. The source and private reference PDF are
hash-bound. Page numbers are zero-based; baselines are in points from page top.
The 0.15 pt tolerance allows PDF coordinate rounding, not a different line box.

Run with a fresh Vite server and locally available Arial:

```sh
node tools/check-top-bottom-flow.mjs http://127.0.0.1:5173/playground.html
```

**Regression history:** At `35583e9a`, 12 of 30 baselines failed, despite
matching twelve-page counts.
The most displaced line is 115.673 pt below the native reference. The reference application allows following text
above a later drawing band; reserving the entire band in the anchor paragraph
loses that space. The control also separates the first cleared paragraph's
before-spacing from the drawing's paragraph-relative positioning base.

Relevant standard: supplied ECMA-376 Part 1 fifth edition, §20.4.2.20
(`wrapTopAndBottom`, printed pp.3136–3137), §§20.4.2.11–12 (position and offset),
and §17.3.1.33 (paragraph spacing). The standard requires top/bottom wrapping;
these native measurements refine paragraph-flow behavior. They do not establish
a reference/spec contradiction or cover all wrapping, columns, tables, and page cuts.

The regression is now a required passing browser check. Pagination retains the
bands separately from the anchor paragraph, allows following content above
them, and clears only intersecting flow. The companion `top-bottom-spacing`
and `top-bottom-table` controls isolate before-spacing and complete-table
clearance. Together the three families cover 27 pages and 82 native baselines.
The actual UI checks editable open, no-edit ZIP preservation, text insertion
with unrelated parts preserved, exact undo and edited reopening.
